source.selection: Observed dirty inputs, including concurrent provider/audit work. Hashes and modes, not a later clean/dirty commit, govern identity.

behavior: Native v2 manager hydration adopts its exact admitted journal instead of persisting inferred active-projection dates.
Native load rereads under the existing append/save lock and atomically rewrites only when required redaction changes bytes; unchanged formatting, including whitespace-only lines, stays exact.
Credential-value redaction and provider credential-key filtering remain on load. Already scrubbed bytes are committed without redacting them again.
The admitted journal is independently owned, not aliased by mutable rich message blocks. Legacy migration and borrowed structural-store persistence retain their existing paths.

Existing message-date inference, active ancestry and subsequent append freshness remain intact; no public schema/API, third-party dependency, runtime control, deadline, retry, tolerance or baseline change.

coverage.reusedScenarios: Two native load paths test date/byte conservation, whitespace, rich-journal isolation and subsequent append; one non-idempotent redactor consistency case; one unknown provider credential-key case. Existing legacy-secret coverage now checks disk immediately after load, before a later mutation.
